methodology: World Quality Index is a weighted composite of normalized CPI (inverted), unemployment (inverted), consumer confidence, happiness, crime rate (inverted), and GDP growth. Pepsi Share = pepsi_index / (pepsi_index + coke_index) using 2-term Google Trends query (available 2004+). The *_3q fields represent a 3-term query (Pepsi, Coca-Cola, Coke) where all three are normalized together — 'Coke' dominates the scale, compressing the others. These are estimated from Google Trends screenshots and should be replaced with pipeline data.
